question: Who is the author of the book 'When Love Came Calling'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Preeti Shenoy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book **'When Love Came Calling'** is authored by **Preeti Shenoy**, who is one of India's most popular and highest-selling contemporary writers.
 
• Published in **September 2020** by **HarperCollins Publishers India**, the novel is a story about two starkly different individuals, **Puja** and **Arush**, exploring themes of **love, self-discovery, and finding one's purpose**.
 
• **Preeti Shenoy** has the distinction of being nominated for the **Forbes India Celebrity 100** list multiple times since **2013**, highlighting her influence in the Indian literary landscape.
 
• The narrative of **'When Love Came Calling'** is set against the backdrop of **life in India and the UK**, focusing on the pressures faced by the **youth** regarding **career choices** and **social expectations**.
 
• This book is considered her **15th book**, adding to her repertoire of **national bestsellers** that often deal with human emotions and relationships in a relatable manner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Preeti Shenoy**:

 
 
• She is an **Indian author** and artist, born in **1971**.
 
• Her notable works include **'Life is What You Make It'**, **'The Secret Wish List'**, and **'A Hundred Little Flames'**.
 
• She is often praised for her **simple yet evocative prose** and has received several awards, including the **Indian of the Year** award by **Brands Academy**.
 
 
 
• **Aruni Kashyap**:
 
 
• He is an **Indian-American** writer and translator from **Assam**.
 
• He is well-known for his debut novel **'The House with a Thousand Stories'** (**2013**), which is set against the backdrop of the **insurgency in Assam**.
 
• He also writes in **Assamese** and serves as an **Associate Professor** of Creative Writing.
 
 
 
• **Chetan Bhagat**:
 
 
• An **Indian author** and columnist, he is famous for his books that cater to the **Indian youth**.
 
• His best-known works include **'Five Point Someone'**, **'The 3 Mistakes of My Life'**, and **'One Indian Girl'**.
 
• Many of his novels have been adapted into **Bollywood movies**, such as **'3 Idiots'** and **'2 States'**.
 
 
 
• **Tanya Selvaratnam**:
 
 
• She is an **Emmy-nominated producer**, activist, and author based in the **United States**.
 
• She authored the book **'Assume Nothing: A Story of Intimate Violence'** (**2021**), which is a powerful **memoir** regarding her personal experiences.
 
• She is also the author of **'The Big Lie: Motherhood, Feminism, and the Reality of the Biological Clock'**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Literary Context**: **Preeti Shenoy's** writing style is frequently categorized as **popular fiction** or **commercial fiction**, making it highly accessible to a broad audience in India.
 
• **Target Audience**: **'When Love Came Calling'** specifically targets the **Young Adult (YA)** demographic, focusing on the **transitional phase** of teenagers entering adulthood.
 
• **Publisher Details**: **HarperCollins India** is a subsidiary of **News Corp** and has been a primary publisher for many of **Shenoy's** recent titles, emphasizing her **commercial success**.
 
• **Societal Themes**: The book highlights the **volunteering culture** and the **gap between parental ambition and child’s passion**, which is a prevalent theme in modern **Indian literature**.
